questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}X&\text{在}[a,b]\text{上服从均匀分布}，\text{其分布函数为}\\F(x)&=\begin{cases}0,&x<a\\ \dfrac{x-a}{b-a},&x\in [a,b],\\1,&x>b\end{cases}\\Z&=\min\{X_1,X_2,\cdots,X_n\}\text{分布函数为}\\F_{X}(x)&=1-[1-F(x)]^n,\\Z&\text{的概率密度为}\\f_{X}(x)&=n[1-F^{n-1}(x)]^{n-1}.f(x)=\dfrac{n(b-x)^{n-1}}{(b-a)^n},\,x\in [a,b].\end{aligned}
